remarks: Welcome to 63 Rowayton Woods Drive, a gem nestled in the highly desirable Rowayton Woods condo complex! This cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo is hitting the market for the first time in over 40 years by its original owner. Step inside to discover a bright living room with built-ins, perfect for hosting your book collection.  The condo boasts a versatile loft/office space, ideal for those who work from home or need a creative nook. You'll love the abundant closet space throughout, ensuring all your storage needs are met. Plus, there's a 5 x 5 storage bin in a dedicated space across from the unit, conveniently located above the garage.  Step out onto the balcony with water views offering a peaceful retreat after a long day. The complex features an in-ground pool, tennis court, a community garden and walking trails, providing plenty of options for relaxation and recreation.  Park in your reserved space located just across from the unit, making everyday errands and commute a little easier. Don't miss this opportunity to own a home in this sought-after community. Schedule your viewing today and envision the possibilities of making this delightful condo your own! This is an As Is sale and priced accordingly.
